meta.label: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE DATA. Generated for tests and demonstration, not real ticket data.
meta.provenance: Produced by tools/build_fixture_store.py from the event specs in that file. Not scraped, not hand-edited, not derived from ticketpath or any market dataset, and never from ticketing-frontend/lib/mock.
meta.notFor: Must not be used to estimate, validate or report any result. Every response carrying it also carries dataSource.synthetic = true.
meta.keyConvention: Every wallet and mint begins with SYN and base58-decodes to 32 bytes, so it is shape-valid and still unmistakably a placeholder. No account exists on any cluster and no explorer will find one.
meta.computedFields: Ledger rows carry priceLamports only. markupBps is computed by ticketpath.core.markup from each ticket's own tier face value, and every price here was built from an integer markup so that recomputation is exact.
meta.missingOnChain: signature and slot are null on every row because this store is synthetic: it is generated from a seed rather than observed, and no transaction was read to produce any row. A program is deployed on devnet, and records/onchain-v2-devnet.json is the record of the run that did it; none of its transactions is a row here.

events.name: Synthetic Hall: Cap Present, Not Binding
events.description: Synthetic demonstration record: a three-tier event with a +25% resale cap that no recorded sale reaches, generated by tools/build_fixture_store.py, not a real show. The record is deliberately over-sampled for demonstration: 62% to 77% of tickets resold at least once on the events that have resales, against ~5.1% of purchased tickets in the real market (class A), 12 to 15 times the real rate.
